final: WITH country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_country_wins FROM country_avg), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - o.avg_country_wins AS diff FROM country_avg ca CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_country_wins), above_group_avg AS (SELECT country, avg_wins, diff FROM above_overall WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM above_overall)) SELECT AVG(avg_wins), AVG(diff), AVG(avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM above_overall)) FROM above_group_avg
